title: Metronome Invoicing Overview

grounding_quotes.text: Metronome offers targeted solutions for invoicing to provide best-in-class support for each billing motion and distribution channel its clients support:
grounding_quotes.supports: The page presents Metronome's invoicing solutions as covering different billing motions and distribution channels.

grounding_quotes.text:
* **Stripe Invoicing:** Metronome natively integrates with Stripe to support client's invoicing needs. Integrate with Stripe invoicing and take advantage of Stripe Tax, dunning, and other features within the Stripe product suite.
* **Marketplace Invoicing:** Metronome's out-of-the-box integration that automates the metering to and creation of invoices in AWS, Azure, and GCP. This integration supports all charge types in Metronome - enabling you to launch a new pricing plan and immediately make it available via marketplace distribution channels. No third-party integrator required.
* **ERP Invoicing:** Metronome provides out-of-the-box and custom integrations to ERPs. Optimized for clients that bill their SLG business or execute revenue workflows inside of ERPs. Seamlessly sync transactions for collection and close your books, complaint with ASC 606 guidelines.
grounding_quotes.supports: This quote grounds the three invoicing solution categories and their described capabilities.

grounding_quotes.text: Metronome believes that optionality and control is important. Some organizations do not need the power of NetSuite invoicing and prefer simpler, integrated solutions. Others, with complex enterprise contracting requirements and revenue processes, need ERP systems. With Metronome, you do not need to choose. Use each capability as it makes sense for your business.
grounding_quotes.supports: This quote grounds the page's emphasis on choosing among invoicing capabilities based on organizational needs.

overview: This page presents Metronome's invoicing overview across Stripe, marketplace, and ERP billing motions and distribution channels. It describes native Stripe invoicing, marketplace invoicing that automates metering and invoice creation for AWS, Azure, and GCP, and out-of-the-box or custom ERP integrations. The page emphasizes optionality and control, allowing organizations to use each capability according to their needs.
key_takeaways: Metronome offers Stripe Invoicing, Marketplace Invoicing, and ERP Invoicing solutions.
Stripe Invoicing natively integrates with Stripe and supports use of Stripe Tax, dunning, and other Stripe product-suite features.
Marketplace Invoicing automates metering and invoice creation for AWS, Azure, and GCP, supports all Metronome charge types, and requires no third-party integrator.
ERP Invoicing provides out-of-the-box and custom ERP integrations for transaction synchronization, collection, book closing, and ASC 606 guidelines.
Metronome describes its invoicing capabilities as optional, so organizations can use simpler integrated solutions or ERP systems according to their requirements.
